source_attestation.method: Sorted relative Go/SQL/go.mod/go.sum SHA-256 manifest digest per module; host and copied Linux test sources match. Documentation excluded.

implementation.owner_text_indexes: Verified typed DDL publication applies mapping additions/removals to the canonical ingestion contract and operation receipt; metadata-only paths retain mappings. No live-index discovery/adoption or automatic API/job activation.
implementation.aggregate_publication: Static template preparation reuses the runtime AST compiler and SQL capability compiler, checks literal/dynamic types and requires registry-version pins plus a separate complete owner preparation guard. Witnesses are not evaluation input/results.
implementation.copying: Bounded coherent scenario/workflow source snapshots; fresh destination identities and ordered child relationships; same-tenant atomic destination mutation, dependency guards and guarded live-copy publication. Standalone workflow copy fences destination model edits. Browser-specific copy audit/provider integration remains open.
implementation.lists: Distinct decision.list.read/decision.list.mutate auth actions; explicitly configured custom-list capability shares staged decision/effect/job transaction. Generic persistence permission does not imply mutation permission.
implementation.maintenance: Inactive shared-scheduler adapter for bounded recovery and three retained-cleanup streams. Pure cursor/scope/stale/error/cancellation tests passed; real scheduler/handler SQL composition remains open.
implementation.rescue_cancellation_race: Revalidate expired transport after owner lock and before interpreting changed execution owner state. Atomic cancellation/completion becomes a stale candidate; missing owner, authorization, rollback and commit failures are not suppressed.

environment.test_databases: Generated disposable decision_* and data_model_* databases on the isolated Compose fixture only.
environment.source_copy: /verification/backend, explicitly copied and checksummed; not the previously stale /backend bind mount.
issues_resolved: Normal and empty-config Docker pulls triggered macOS credential-helper error -50. A temporary config with an empty Docker Hub auth entry allowed an anonymous public pull; saved Docker configuration/credentials were untouched.

Docker VM I/O pressure delayed image extraction and old fixture removal. Started only the already-created private pinned fixture; Compose then completed healthy. No daemon restart or application-container changes.

Initial text-index publication fixture used field_score while its new field registered a different label. Corrected the fixture's short ASCII label and matching physical column; production verification and timeouts were not weakened.

verification.includes: 140-step fresh/repeated/scoped prefix installations; cleanup across seven kinds, rescue/exhaustion, callback rollback, concurrency/stale fences, calendar, retry/redrive, 5000-row real rescue-query EXPLAIN ANALYZE

verification.limitations: Authoring, execution and wallet AST corpus only; HTTP comparison uses an SQL-backed contract endpoint, not a deployed ingestion service.

verification.includes: Owner relationships, rollback, restricted boundary, tenant/concurrency, authoring/history/configuration/effects/registry/browser fixtures and representative scoped plans.

All allocated publication subcases, lost-ack/commit fault injection, ownership/permission/schema errors, concurrent results, text-index retention/version/receipt and invalid-archive rollback, populated DDL create/drop.

verification.limitations: Affected MySQL/AST or contract/MySQL package trees, not full-repository vet.
Compile only, not service/HTTP behavioral acceptance.
